scripts.dev:provider: pnpm --filter @flex/provider run seed:mock && pnpm --filter @flex/provider run start:dev
scripts.dev:provider2: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.provider2 MOCK_DISCOGRAPHY=2 sh -c 'pnpm --filter @flex/provider exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm run dev:provider'
scripts.reset:back: pnpm --filter @flex/back exec prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && pnpm --filter @flex/back run seed:accounts
scripts.reset:provider: pnpm --filter @flex/provider exec prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && pnpm --filter @flex/provider run seed:mock
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:init && pnpm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,back,front -c yellow,blue,red "pnpm --filter @flex/shared run dev" "pnpm --filter @flex/back start:dev" "wait-on tcp:localhost:3001 && pnpm --filter @flex/front start"
scripts.lint: pnpm run build:shared && concurrently -n back,provider,front,shared -c blue,green,red,yellow "pnpm --filter @flex/back run lint" "pnpm --filter @flex/provider run lint" "pnpm --filter @flex/front run lint" "pnpm --filter @flex/shared run lint"
scripts.check: pnpm run build:shared && concurrently -n back,provider,front,shared -c blue,green,red,yellow "pnpm --filter @flex/back run check" "pnpm --filter @flex/provider run check" "pnpm --filter @flex/front run check" "pnpm --filter @flex/shared run check"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && concurrently -n back,provider,front -c blue,green,red "pnpm --filter @flex/back build" "pnpm --filter @flex/provider build" "pnpm --filter @flex/front build"
